impact: A sign Nvidia is trimming non-core bets during its leadership shake-up; chip sentiment, including MU, DRAM and NBIS, hinges on tonight's guide.
summary: Intel fell 3.3% in premarket trading Tuesday after Nvidia cut its stake in the company by 25%, Reuters reported. US futures slipped ahead of Nvidia's results after the close, with Nvidia down about 0.4% premarket and neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius off about 2% and 0.6%. Micron enters the report at $719.02 after a 7.6% drop Monday.
title: Nvidia cuts Intel stake by 25%; Intel falls 3.3% premarket
